verdict.rationale: Bento documents reusable email templates that update everywhere they are used, and says templates can be built with a drag-and-drop editor. Personalization is only implied: custom fields store per-person data, but Liquid variables are documented for webhook payloads, not email content. Nothing in the pack shows that emails render correctly across clients. Missing for 10: documented email personalization tokens/merge tags, cross-client rendering or preview/testing evidence, brand-kit or on-brand styling controls, independent hands-on corroboration of the editor.
